description: Retrospective twin of Live Cells, Inverter & Faults (orion_live_kafka_rt_v1), from the orion Postgres DB. The time picker and Zoom both narrow the range; stats summarise the whole range.

panels.description: Hottest reading of each cells_temps[i] in the range. Bars at 0 are sensors with no data.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(p.start_time, $__from) AS t0, LEAST(p.end_time, $__to) AS t1
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE (COALESCE(array_length(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[], 1), 0) = 0
         OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[]))
    AND p.end_time >= $__from AND p.start_time <= $__to
)
SELECT (u.i - 1)::text AS "Cell index", MAX(u.v) AS "Max"
FROM packet JOIN pack USING (packet_id), unnest(pack.cells_temps) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(v, i)
WHERE packet.time BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bounds b WHERE packet.time BETWEEN b.t0 AND b.t1)
  AND packet.time % 500 < 50
GROUP BY u.i
ORDER BY u.i

panels.title: Cell temperatures, max per cell over range

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (

WHERE packet.time BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bounds b WHERE packet.time BETWEEN b.t0 AND b.t1)
  AND packet.time % 500 < 50

panels.title: Pedal faults in range

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(p.start_time, $__from) AS t0, LEAST(p.end_time, $__to) AS t1
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE (COALESCE(array_length(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[], 1), 0) = 0
         OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[]))
    AND p.end_time >= $__from AND p.start_time <= $__to
),
seg AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(s.start_time, (SELECT MIN(t0) FROM bounds)) AS t0,
         LEAST(s.end_time, (SELECT MAX(t1) FROM bounds)) AS t1, s.state,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(s.active_faults, ''), 'None') AS active_faults,
         lead(s.start_time) OVER (ORDER BY s.start_time) AS nxt
  FROM car_status_segment s
  WHERE s.car = 'orion' AND s.end_time >= $__from AND s.start_time <= $__to
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bounds b WHERE s.end_time >= b.t0 AND s.start_time <= b.t1)
)
SELECT to_timestamp(t / 1000.0) AS time, state, active_faults FROM (
  SELECT t0 AS t, state, active_faults FROM seg
  -- segments abut ~50 ms apart; a null marker only where no segment follows within 5 s (server or car off)
  UNION ALL SELECT t1 + 1, NULL, NULL FROM seg WHERE nxt IS NULL OR nxt > t1 + 5000
) x
ORDER BY t

panels.description: Per time bucket: faults show if set at any point, legs/contactors/R2D show OPEN if open at any point, HVC shows ERROR if it hit ERROR, else its most common state.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(p.start_time, $__from) AS t0, LEAST(p.end_time, $__to) AS t1

  CASE WHEN bool_or(hvc_state_machine = 4) THEN 4 ELSE mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY hvc_state_machine) END AS "hvc_state_machine",

  bool_and(neg_hv_contactor) AS "neg_hv_contactor",

  bool_and(shutdown_leg1) AS "shutdown_leg1",
  bool_and(shutdown_leg2) AS "shutdown_leg2",
  bool_and(shutdown_leg3) AS "shutdown_leg3",
  bool_and(shutdown_leg4) AS "shutdown_leg4",
  bool_or(imd_gnd_isolation_error) AS "imd_gnd_isolation_error",
  bool_or(bmb_comm_error) AS "bmb_comm_error",
  bool_or(stomp_fault) AS "stomp_fault",
  bit_or(post_faults::bigint) AS "post_faults",
  bit_or(run_faults::bigint) AS "run_faults"
FROM packet JOIN diagnostics_high USING (packet_id) JOIN diagnostics_low USING (packet_id)
WHERE packet.time BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bounds b WHERE packet.time BETWEEN b.t0 AND b.t1)

  COALESCE(MIN(pack.lv_batt_v) FILTER (WHERE pack.lv_batt_v > 0), 0) AS "lv_batt_v"
FROM packet JOIN pack USING (packet_id)
WHERE packet.time BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bounds b WHERE packet.time BETWEEN b.t0 AND b.t1)

FROM packet JOIN pack USING (packet_id) JOIN controls USING (packet_id)
WHERE packet.time BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bounds b WHERE packet.time BETWEEN b.t0 AND b.t1)
